instruction: Configure document permissions to allow specific users to only comment without editing privileges

metadata.explanation: LibreOffice Writer does not have user-based permission systems for granular access control. While document protection features exist, they cannot assign different permission levels to specific users. This task is infeasible.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - LibreOffice Writer does not support user-specific permission levels (only document-level protection)
The 'infeasible' evaluator is semantically correct for tasks requesting functionality that doesn't exist in the application
The metadata explanation correctly identifies why this task cannot be completed
No verification logic is needed or appropriate for infeasible tasks
